arxiv_1b81hrf.ai_summary: RoboDream introduces compositional world models to synthesize large‑scale, diverse robot demonstrations, tackling the high cost and time demands of teleoperation‑based data collection. arxiv_1b7xj0n.ai_summary: SN-WER introduces a script‑normalized version of Word Error Rate that aligns reference and hypothesis texts to a common script before computing errors, preventing overestimation when ASR outputs are romanized. arxiv_1b7z3gu.ai_summary: IntraShuffler introduces a privacy‑preserving framework for heterogeneous differential privacy in federated learning, letting each client choose its own ε budget based on policy and data sensitivity. arxiv_1b7z3gu.title: IntraShuffler: A Privacy Preserving Framework for Heterogeneous DP Federated Learning

arxiv_1b7zxm4.ai_summary: The paper introduces a mixture‑density model that assigns multiple depth hypotheses per pixel to resolve depth ambiguity at object boundaries. arxiv_1b7zxm4.title: Modeling Depth Ambiguity: A Mixture-Density Representation for Flying-Point-Free Depth Estimation

arxiv_1b7z49b.ai_summary: The paper presents verifiable belief‑space neural safety filters that enable permissive safety by modeling human preferences, goals, competency, and willingness to cooperate.
